verdict.rationale: Statsig documents both client and server SDKs that evaluate gates locally after initialization (docs-39), and states that evaluation is deterministic and returns the same result across client and server platforms (docs-7). Web usage is shown through the JavaScript SDK and React StatsigProvider (docs-24, docs-36), and server SDKs, on-device client SDKs, target apps and persistent assignment round out the consistency story. The HTTP API is positioned as a fallback only when no SDK exists for a language (docs-37). Missing for 10: an explicit list of supported SDK languages, explicit evidence of official iOS/Android or other mobile SDKs (only mobile-platform targeting is mentioned), and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-platform consistency.
